judgments.reason: The model text does not articulate the claimed mechanism that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that bids exceeding coins can win; trace shows no rounds where such a discrepancy was observed.

The model never states that waiting reveals sealed rival bid values before committing; observations and trace show rival bids remained sealed and no precommit information advantage was recognized or exploited.

The model does not claim or demonstrate that 'close' can settle with unauctioned lots or that settlement occurred early; the play trace shows normal unresolved lots at the horizon and no early-settlement discrepancy.
The model did not articulate that catalog purchases receive the auction commission; evidence shows catalog buys are distinguished from auction wins and no such substitution was observed.
